presentationTable.name: Base Warehouse - Inventory Snapshot KPIs

presentationColumns.name: Snapshot Week Start Date
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot Week Start Date
presentationColumns.description: Week represented by the base inventory snapshot. Include it when analyzing inventory history or validating latest-known inventory status.

presentationColumns.name: Date Key
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Date Key

presentationColumns.name: Store ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Store ID

presentationColumns.name: SKU ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.SKU ID

presentationColumns.name: Collection ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Collection ID

presentationColumns.name: Snapshot On Hand Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot On Hand Units
presentationColumns.description: Physical stock on hand in the weekly inventory snapshot at store-SKU-week grain. Use it for point-in-time operational inventory reporting; use Inventory Movement KPIs for opening-to-ending flow analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Snapshot Available Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot Available Units
presentationColumns.description: Sellable units in the weekly inventory snapshot after reservations or unavailable stock are excluded. Use it for point-in-time availability reporting.

presentationColumns.name: Snapshot Reserved Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot Reserved Units
presentationColumns.description: Reserved units in the weekly inventory snapshot that are physically on hand but not immediately sellable.

presentationColumns.name: Latest Known Store-SKU On Hand Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Latest Known Store-SKU On Hand Units
presentationColumns.description: Last known physical stock on hand at store-SKU grain. Use this with the snapshot week to understand store availability when a SKU is not present in every weekly inventory snapshot.

presentationColumns.name: Latest Known Store-SKU Available Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Latest Known Store-SKU Available Units
presentationColumns.description: Last known sellable inventory at store-SKU grain after reservations and unavailable stock. Use this with the snapshot week to identify possible transfer candidates and judge how fresh the inventory status is.

presentationColumns.name: Latest Known Store-SKU Reserved Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Latest Known Store-SKU Reserved Units
presentationColumns.description: Last known reserved inventory at store-SKU grain. Use this beside latest known available units to understand why on-hand stock may not be fully transferable.

presentationColumns.name: Snapshot Stockout Count
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot Stockout Count
presentationColumns.description: Count of weekly store-SKU snapshots flagged as stockout. This is an operational snapshot count, not an AI alert count.

presentationColumns.name: Snapshot Inventory Value At Cost
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot Inventory Value At Cost
presentationColumns.description: Inventory value at standard cost for the weekly inventory snapshot.

presentationColumns.name: Average Snapshot Weeks Of Supply
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Average Snapshot Weeks Of Supply
presentationColumns.description: Average estimated weeks of supply across weekly inventory snapshots in the selected context.

presentationColumns.name: Average Store-SKU Overstock Risk Index
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Average Store-SKU Overstock Risk Index
presentationColumns.description: Historical average raw overstock risk index at store-SKU-week grain; not scaled to 0-100.

presentationColumns.name: Average Store-SKU Stockout Risk Index
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Average Store-SKU Stockout Risk Index
presentationColumns.description: Historical average raw stockout risk index at store-SKU-week grain; not scaled to 0-100.

presentationColumns.name: Current Store-SKU Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Current Store-SKU Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Latest-week store-SKU stockout risk rescaled to a 0-100 dashboard score. Use this for current inventory risk because it avoids diluting the latest state with older weeks.

presentationColumns.name: Current Store-SKU Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Current Store-SKU Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Latest-week store-SKU overstock risk rescaled to a 0-100 dashboard score. Use this for current overstock monitoring because it reflects the latest available inventory snapshot.

presentationColumns.name: Snapshot Available Unit Share
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot Available Unit Share
presentationColumns.description: Snapshot available units as a percentage of snapshot on-hand units.

presentationColumns.name: Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.description: Internal data-generation scenario marker; hidden from business-facing analysis.

presentationTable.description: Base warehouse weekly inventory snapshots from FASHIONDW.FACT_INVENTORY_SNAPSHOT_WEEKLY. Use this for stock position, latest known availability, and snapshot risk reporting.
